Query.Sql: select patient_identifier_value, EVENT_END_DT_TM, EVENT, md5(to_json(row(WAREHOUSE_IDENTIFIER, EVENT_END_DT_TM, EVENT, RESULT_VALUE, RESULT_UNITS, NORMAL_LOW, NORMAL_HIGH))) as record_connection_identifier from ##duckdb_source## where trim(EVENT) = 'Tracheostomy In Situ' and lower(trim(RESULT_VALUE)) = 'yes' order by all

Explanation.Description: Stable hash of the warehouse identifier and original event timestamp, name, result, units and ranges, preserving distinct positive readings across batches and identifying identical rows on reruns.
Event end timestamp supplies condition start date and datetime; no condition end is inferred.
Original tracheostomy-in-situ event. Only Yes answers are selected; No and other answers are excluded.
